page.overview:
Who is Arnold?

Arnold was a boy who lived in or before the 19th century.

At some point, Arnold left to hunt meat for his father Dermot and mother Beatrice, who needed food, intending to return home in a day or two. He also wanted to prove to his parents that "the beasts" were not possessed by Dark Magic, as his father had claimed. Arnold left a letter for his father when he left to hunt. He did not return for a week, which prompted Dermot to go look for him.
